describe: make a traffic light with several LEDs
guide: Never choose a pin. If the message does not say which pin, ask. Pins 0 and 1 are the USB connection; never use them for a part.
Three LEDs, three named pin constants, each through its own resistor. In loop(): green on, wait, amber on, wait, red on, wait -- one at a time. Put each pin in wiring.md.
